policy_content_bindings.subject: CRM Meeting Record Policy
policy_content_bindings.body_plain:
Team,

When scheduling meetings from inbox requests, follow these rules:

EXCLUDED (do NOT schedule): Requests where ALL attendees are from our own @company.example.com domain. Internal-only syncs are tracked separately in the team calendar.

ELIGIBLE: Any meeting with at least one external attendee (non-@company.example.com email domain).

REQUIRED: For all eligible meetings, include the Salesforce contact ID in the calendar event description so we can link back to the CRM record.

- Ops Team

policy_content_bindings.body_plain:
Team,

For reference, our standard meeting durations:
- Demo: 60 minutes
- Quick sync: 30 minutes
- Strategic partnership discussions: 60 minutes

These are guidelines only.

- Ops
